form.label: CoolaShaker - Database Performance
form.description: SQL Server monitoring and performance analysis

search.query: index=demo_mssql location=$location_token$ event_type=performance | eval db_host=mvindex(host, 0) | fields _time location db_host database cpu_pct memory_mb active_connections transactions_per_sec batch_requests_per_sec buffer_cache_hit_ratio page_life_expectancy disk_queue_length lock_waits_per_sec deadlocks_per_sec

index=demo_mssql location=$location_token$ event_type=query_performance | eval db_host=mvindex(host, 0) | fields _time location db_host database query duration_ms cpu_time_ms logical_reads physical_reads row_count

index=demo_mssql location=$location_token$ event_type=log_status | eval db_host=mvindex(host, 0) | fields _time location db_host database log_file_size_mb log_space_used_pct log_growth_rate_mb_per_min
index=demo_mssql location=$location_token$ event_type=backup | eval db_host=mvindex(host, 0) | fields _time location db_host database backup_type status duration_sec size_mb error_message

| stats avg(cpu_pct) as avg_cpu | eval avg_cpu=round(avg_cpu, 1) | eval range=case( avg_cpu <= 70, "low", avg_cpu <= 90, "elevated", 1=1, "severe") | rangemap field=avg_cpu low=0-70 elevated=70-90 severe=90-100

| stats avg(buffer_cache_hit_ratio) as avg_cache | eval avg_cache=round(avg_cache, 1) | eval range=case( avg_cache >= 95, "low", avg_cache >= 90, "elevated", 1=1, "severe") | rangemap field=avg_cache low=95-100 elevated=90-95 severe=0-90
| stats avg(transactions_per_sec) as avg_tps | eval avg_tps=round(avg_tps, 0)

| stats sum(deadlocks_per_sec) as total_deadlocks | eval range=case( total_deadlocks = 0, "low", total_deadlocks <= 5, "elevated", 1=1, "severe") | rangemap field=total_deadlocks low=0-0 elevated=1-5 severe=6-999
| timechart span=5m avg(transactions_per_sec) as "Transactions/sec", avg(batch_requests_per_sec) as "Batch Requests/sec" by db_host
| timechart span=5m avg(disk_queue_length) as "Disk Queue", avg(lock_waits_per_sec) as "Lock Waits/sec", avg(deadlocks_per_sec) as "Deadlocks/sec" by db_host
| timechart span=10m avg(log_file_size_mb) as "Log Size (MB)", avg(log_space_used_pct) as "Space Used %" by db_host
| stats avg(duration_ms) as avg_duration, max(duration_ms) as max_duration, count by db_host | eval avg_duration=round(avg_duration, 0), max_duration=round(max_duration, 0)

| stats latest(cpu_pct) as "CPU %", latest(memory_mb) as "Memory (MB)", latest(active_connections) as "Connections", avg(transactions_per_sec) as "Avg TPS", latest(buffer_cache_hit_ratio) as "Cache Hit %", latest(page_life_expectancy) as "PLE", sum(deadlocks_per_sec) as "Deadlocks" by location db_host | eval "CPU %"=round('CPU %', 1), "Memory (MB)"=round('Memory (MB)', 0), "Avg TPS"=round('Avg TPS', 0), "Cache Hit %"=round('Cache Hit %', 1), "PLE"=round('PLE', 0) | sort location db_host | rename location as Location, db_host as "Database Server"

|head 10 | eval query_time=strftime(_time, "%H:%M:%S")| stats values(*) as * by query, location,query_time | sort -duration_ms | table query_time location db_host query duration_ms cpu_time_ms logical_reads physical_reads | rename query_time as "Time", location as "Location", db_host as "Server", query as "Query", duration_ms as "Duration (ms)", cpu_time_ms as "CPU Time (ms)", logical_reads as "Logical Reads", physical_reads as "Physical Reads"

| stats latest(log_file_size_mb) as "Log Size (MB)", latest(log_space_used_pct) as "Space Used %", avg(log_growth_rate_mb_per_min) as "Growth Rate (MB/min)" by location db_host | eval "Log Size (MB)"=round('Log Size (MB)', 0), "Space Used %"=round('Space Used %', 1), "Growth Rate (MB/min)"=round('Growth Rate (MB/min)', 1) | sort location db_host | rename location as Location, db_host as "Database Server"

| stats latest(backup_type) as "Type", latest(status) as "Status", latest(duration_sec) as "Duration (sec)", latest(size_mb) as "Size (MB)", latest(error_message) as "Error" by location db_host | eval "Duration (sec)"=round('Duration (sec)', 0), "Size (MB)"=round('Size (MB)', 0) | sort -_time | rename location as Location, db_host as "Database Server"

index=demo_mssql location=$location_token$ event_type=wait_stats | eval db_host=mvindex(host, 0) | stats sum(wait_time_ms) as "Total Wait Time (ms)", avg(wait_time_ms) as "Avg Wait Time (ms)", sum(waiting_tasks_count) as "Total Waiting Tasks" by location db_host wait_type | eval "Total Wait Time (ms)"=round('Total Wait Time (ms)', 0), "Avg Wait Time (ms)"=round('Avg Wait Time (ms)', 1) | sort -"Total Wait Time (ms)" | head 15 | rename location as Location, db_host as "Server", wait_type as "Wait Type"
